safety_verdicts.content: Visual problems persist but with some improvement.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes ongoing visual symptoms but does not capture the 'some improvement' component.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that visual symptoms are “still ongoing but slightly improved” loses trajectory detail, but does not materially change triage or core differential in a patient already reporting persistent visual disturbance. This is mainly documentation granularity rather than a change in management.

safety_verdicts.content: Looking at screens worsens the symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention symptoms worsening with looking at screens.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting symptom worsening with screens misses a migraine-supporting feature (light/sensory sensitivity) and may reduce clarity of the clinical picture. However, it is unlikely on its own to change immediate safety-critical decisions given other prominent migraine-associated symptoms already present (unilateral headache, nausea/vomiting, visual phenomena).
